invariants.rationale: Method usage of data.stream() in the body assumes data is not null.
Method applies a wrapper around the func, implying it must not be null.
The parallelism parameter is used as an Integer object, so it should not be null at entry.
Parallelism usually refers to the number of threads or partitions, which is expected to be positive.
It is common to set parallelism less than or equal to the data size, unless data is empty.
